title: Southwest Finland: 3.4 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €141,330 a year
markdown:
# Southwest Finland: 3.4 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €141,330 a year

> Closes 3.4 of 7.8 missing patients a year (43%) · €141,330 of €1.00M · €858,670 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Southwest Finland, 24 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 8 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 17.4 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 10.8–23.7). [^care_curative][^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, about 6.0 fewer patients a year are operated and 1.8 fewer get radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative][^model] Part of this gap may be treatment that was given but not recorded. [^care_no_record][^care_life_prolonging]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 24.3% to 25.5% by 2028: 3.4 more patients a year (range 0.0–6.4), for €141,330 a year, about €42,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 43% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (7.8 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Step zero: fix the records (no direct effect)** | | | | |
| 0 | **Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record**[^ev_recording_audit_1]. Chief physician of oncology and the head of clinical coding | €8,000 | 0.0 | Pull 50 patients diagnosed in 2023 with no treatment on record and check their charts this month. | Share of patients with no treatment on record: 43.1% → 27.5% by 2027 |
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €59,480 | 2.3 (0.0–4.1) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 24.3% → 25.1% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €73,850 | 1.1 (0.0–2.3) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 24.3% → 24.7% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€141,330** | **3.4 (0.0–6.4)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €1.51M a year; modelled to avoid 2.6 deaths a year (0.6–6.9). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 24.3% (2019–2023, measured) → 25.5% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients with no treatment on record: 43.1% → 27.5% by 2027. [^care_no_record][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €858,670 buys nothing more toward treating patients to cure. [^model] €141,330 already funds every measure that adds to it, and these measures are limited by the reachable shortfall, not money. [^model] Doing more would take a national decision on low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, or ranking measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer kills about 207 people a year in Southwest Finland, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.5 of those deaths (range 0.0–1.9). [^deaths][^model]

## Limits

- No trial has measured these effects, so they are assumptions. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest, not a probability. [^model]
- Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, other illness, histology or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- Recorded drug therapy is 0.9% here against 25.1% nationally, and 43.1% have no treatment on record. Audit the records before reading this as a gap in care. [^care_drug_therapy][^care_no_record]
